shared_elements: a head with rendered facial features (eyes, mouth/muzzle)
a creature/being depicted with teeth or jaw emphasized (A) vs animal muzzle (B)
incised repeating surface patterning (A's row of teeth-like marks; B's fleece curls)
justification: Both surfaces depict a head with articulated eyes and mouth and some repeated incised patterning, but that is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A shows a crude, frontal, schematic human-like face stacked beneath a gaping toothed mouth on a columnar figure, while B shows a single horned animal head in profile with naturalistically modelled eye, ear and nostril and dense conventionalized curl-patterned fleece — different subjects, viewpoints and depictive conventions.
